title: Complete MACA Programs need their own optimization measurement qualification

locators: attention-component-summary.json: retained four-stage component correctness, event and separate profile observation

evidence.scope: A CPU-built two-stage Program and source audit establish an Executor measurement gap. They do not establish a native hardware limitation or provide device qualification. No existing Run was edited or repeated.

observation: C1 can construct and seal an ordered MCFATBIN Program for independent correctness checks, but an optimization environment refuses its timing and attribution because the admitted instruments cover one dispatch. A single-kernel success does not qualify the complete Program interval. NativeTritonEnvironment is also single-kernel and cannot serve as an implicit multi-stage escape route.
proposed_change: Keep the existing Program and Ralph owners. Admit exact-target event and attribution adapters after reviewed complete-Program device component evidence and its source relation. Then require a fresh common-worker fixed-baseline A/A and separate attribution through the existing external performance_qualified gate before controlled author submission. Preserve default-stream event mean10, fresh-output checks, stage-call accounting and aligned-variant refusal.
promotion_disposition: Adapter availability is reviewed for exact xcore1002 based on retained four-stage solx_fib.attention component correctness across five input cases, two five-sample event cohorts and independent full-Program MCPTI profiling. Existing readers replay those records. The relevant Evaluation, worker, measurement policy, Lab build/runtime and qualification-tool source has no changes between component d9b92681 and base 6b3f3ff3; this is not whole-source or host equivalence. The availability source change is 49c867d6. Real common-worker A/A and per-baseline external performance_qualified readiness remain pending. TaskLab has no intrinsic prior-A/A invariant. The Finding remains open; no Compiler optimization or Bench performance claim is promoted.
